source_dependency.reason: Original four Frac outputs require the source Prod continuation override; Frac is not reimplemented.

procedures: Overset traverses only the base, preserving an annotation linebreak as source content.
Mod first-operand continuation hides the original glyph, retains it in the continuation, and clears the original second operand.
Mod second-operand continuation starts without a first operand and hides its glyph.
Mod MathML always includes the operator mi; hiding leaves that element empty.
OMML retains the existing operator renderer, with source receiver admission for invalid operand arrays.
scope: Default and split line-breaking paths; existing writer context is propagated unchanged.
No independent parser/arithmetic, source bridge or whole-input lookup.
Source exception classes are qualified, not their message bytes.
